newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices hold due to holiday.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices hold due to holiday.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were unchanged Tuesday as most traders were absent from the market due to the Canada Day holiday.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub held at C$1.45-1.465 per gigajoule, traders said.
Temperatures in Calgary were forecast to reach highs in the high-60s F on Wednesday and Thursday, Weather Services Corp reported.
At Sumas, Wash., prices were quoted at $1.10-1.13 per million British thermal units (mmBtu), indicating a decline of about 25 cents from June indices.
